summary: Backend regression suite passed all 3 tests. UI loaded and initial controls rendered, but the booking flow produced a React runtime crash after submission in the browser.

ui_bugs.issue: React runtime error: Objects are not valid as a React child (object keys type, loc, msg, input, url) after booking submission; payment QR never renders.

integration_issues.issue: Browser flow crashes before UPI QR/payment verification despite identical public API payload returning 200 via requests.

action_items: Fix booking transition runtime crash and ensure API validation errors are converted to strings before rendering.
Retest full booking/payment/tracker and staff/doctor flows after fix.
critical_code_review_comments: Booking catches e.response.data.detail and renders it directly; Pydantic detail can be an object/list, causing React child runtime crash.
Frontend API calls generally lack user-visible error handling on desk/doctor mutations, allowing silent integration failures.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST Patient and Browser Test appointments during API/browser testing on future dates; no cleanup endpoint exists.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Schedule rules, booking API, payment verification API, queue persistence, prescription completion, records, PIN verification all passed via requests. Browser initial page loaded and booked-slot disabling worked. Browser booking transition crashed before QR; desk/doctor/records/mobile flows remain unverified.
rca of the issue: The rendered runtime error is React's invalid-child error for a validation object. App.js Booking renders error state directly in <span>; when Axios receives structured validation detail, setError stores the object and React crashes. Normalize detail to a string and investigate the browser request/state race that generated validation detail.
